Released 10 November 2025 · Release notes for this version

The game is for Windows and macOS only, not phones or tablets. Copy or share this page to open it on a computer.

Only Windows and macOS builds are available. There is no Linux build; your device was not identified as a supported desktop.

Installation and details

Windows

The Windows export targets x86-64 (64-bit Intel/AMD). The publisher does not specify a minimum Windows version.

  1. Download GrayZoneWin.zip.
  2. Right-click the ZIP file and choose “Extract All”. Keep all extracted files together in the same folder.
  3. Open the extracted folder and launch the .exe application, not from inside the ZIP archive.

macOS

The macOS export targets Universal (Intel x86-64 and Apple Silicon arm64). Its export settings declare macOS 10.12 for Intel and macOS 11.0 for Apple Silicon; these are not verified game-tested minimums.

  1. Download GrayZoneMac.zip and open the ZIP file to extract it.
  2. Move the extracted .app application to Applications, then open it from there.

The publisher has not specified minimum RAM or confirmed game-tested operating system versions. Check the release notes or contact the team for compatibility details.

If your operating system blocks opening the app, check the source and SHA-256 checksum first. Do not disable security protections; contact the authors if you do not understand the warning.

Your choices. Your integrity.

You play a high school senior applying for a scholarship abroad. The deadline is close: gather documents, deal with institutions, prepare for an English test, and make it through the interview.

At every step, choose between doing the work honestly and taking a corrupt shortcut. Your decisions affect integrity, reputation, time, and money—and lead to different endings. Getting the scholarship is only part of the challenge. How you earn it matters.

Made for young people and educators

  • Recognise corruption in everyday situations, including favours and seemingly harmless shortcuts.
  • Practise critical thinking, weigh consequences, and reflect on integrity and honesty.
  • Use the game to start discussions in classrooms and non-formal learning settings.

Game Tutorial

The wheel turns by itself. Drag it, or pick a step.Pick a step or use the arrows. Screens do not advance automatically.Read the steps and explore the in-game screenshots.

01Status Bar
02Task Overview
03Task Details
04Dialogues
05Activities
06Settings
07The Gray Zone

  1. Step 01 / 07

    Status Bar

    Click a button to show detailed info

  2. Step 02 / 07

    Task Overview

    Your tasks are displayed on the board.

    Each card is a main objective you can work on.

    New tasks appear here as the story progresses.

    The board helps you track what’s important at a glance.

    Clicking T opens and closes the Task Overview

  3. Step 03 / 07

    Task Details

    Green text = task completed.

    Red text = task failed.

    Clicking a task opens its detailed view, showing every step clearly.

  4. Step 04 / 07

    Dialogues

    Click a character to start a conversation.

    Some options are one-time — think before you commit.

  5. Step 05 / 07

    Activities

    The Action button is your way of checking what’s available in each location.

    Instead of guessing, open it and you’ll always see what can be done here and now.

    It also shows the travel options, letting you move between locations at the right times.

  6. Step 06 / 07

    Settings

    Open the Settings menu by pressing ESC.

    Settings let you adjust Sound (overall volume) and Music (game music volume).

    The game does not pause when the menu is open — time and activities keep running in the background.

  7. Step 07 / 07

    The Gray Zone

    The world reacts to your decisions, big and small.

    You can take the honest route, exploit shortcuts, or stay in the gray zone.

    Every action leaves a mark — some visible right away, others only later.

Your privacy

Optional Google Analytics helps us understand how this site is used. It stays off unless you accept. You can decline and use the whole site, or change your choice at any time.

How your data is used

If you accept, Google Analytics uses cookies and receives information about your browser, device and visits to this site. Declining or withdrawing consent stops analytics collection on this site and removes its accessible Google Analytics cookies. Data already sent to Google is not deleted by withdrawing consent.

We store only your analytics choice in this browser’s local storage so we can remember it between visits. The site also uses session storage to remember the light/dark appearance and whether the introduction has already played. These essential preferences do not require analytics consent. If storage is unavailable, your analytics choice lasts only for this page.

Google processes analytics data under its own privacy terms. We do not enable Google advertising signals or advertising personalization. Google privacy policy

Game downloads are hosted directly on GitHub. Following a download link contacts GitHub, which processes connection information under its own privacy terms, independently of your analytics choice. GitHub privacy statement
